items.title: “2026夜游经济发展大会”将于12月6日在北京召开
items.titleEn: 2026 Night Tourism Economy Conference to Open in Beijing on December 6
items.summary: 大会聚焦文化赋能、数字技术与沉浸式夜游，探索城市夜间文旅的新场景和新消费。
items.summaryEn: The conference focuses on culture, digital technology and immersive night experiences, exploring new urban tourism scenes and spending.

items.title: 佛山市乐平镇：“百千万工程”引领下的镇域振兴样本
items.titleEn: Leping Town, Foshan: A Rural Revitalisation and Tourism Model
items.summary: 从工业重镇到文旅融合样本，乐平镇以乡村振兴带动休闲旅游和目的地更新。
items.summaryEn: This industrial town is building a rural-tourism model that links revitalisation with leisure travel and destination renewal.

items.title: “2025光影演艺产业大会”成功召开
items.titleEn: 2025 Light and Shadow Performance Industry Conference Held in Guangzhou
items.summary: 行业代表围绕演艺新空间、沉浸体验和消费升级，讨论光影演艺如何赋能城市文旅。
items.summaryEn: Industry leaders discuss how light-and-shadow performances can energise urban tourism through new venues, immersive experiences and upgraded spending.

items.title: 第十七届新疆冬博会暨2023新疆热雪节新闻发布会在京举行
items.titleEn: 17th Xinjiang Winter Tourism Expo and 2023 Snow Festival Announced
items.summary: 活动将体育赛事、冰雪旅游和文化演艺结合，为冬季家庭出行提供更多目的地灵感。
items.summaryEn: The event combines winter sports, snow tourism and cultural performances, offering more inspiration for family winter trips.

items.title: 《灵境·麒麟山》即将点亮三明城市“岁月客厅”
items.titleEn: Immersive “Realm of Qilin Mountain” to Light Up Sanming
items.summary: 城市公园正在成为夜间文旅新场景，沉浸式演出与地方文化结合，为家庭夜游提供新选择。
items.summaryEn: Urban parks are becoming new night-tourism settings, combining immersive performances with local culture for family evenings.

items.title: 三星堆又现新发现！携程导游：三星堆文博游已经连火两年
items.titleEn: Sanxingdui Museum Travel Remains a Cultural Tourism Favourite
items.summary: 文博游热度持续上升，三星堆等博物馆成为亲子家庭了解历史和城市文化的重要一站。
items.summaryEn: Museum travel keeps growing, with sites such as Sanxingdui becoming engaging stops for families learning about history and local culture.

items.title: 中国 10 佳酒店：2026 读者选择奖
items.titleEn: 10 Top Hotels in China 2026: Readers' Choice Awards
items.summary: 榜单覆盖北京、上海、深圳、成都、丽江和香港等地，适合寻找高品质住宿的家庭与长途旅行者参考。
items.summaryEn: The list spans Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Chengdu, Lijiang and Hong Kong, offering a high-end stay reference for families and longer trips.

items.title: 中国最值得一去的 13 个地方
items.titleEn: 13 Best Places to Visit in China
items.summary: 从北京、上海到四川、云南和广西，这篇外媒指南按目的地特色梳理中国旅行路线，适合第一次来中国的家庭参考。
items.summaryEn: From Beijing and Shanghai to Sichuan, Yunnan and Guangxi, this international guide connects China's standout destinations for first-time family visitors.

items.title: 来中国最值得体验的 8 件事
items.titleEn: 8 Best Things to Do in China
items.summary: 文章从文化遗址、城市街区、自然景观和地方美食切入，帮助旅客把中国目的地变成可执行的完整体验。
items.summaryEn: From cultural landmarks and city districts to landscapes and local food, the guide turns China destinations into practical travel experiences.
